description: Static scan of the SpectraCQ v1.0 design-phase RAN1 Cypher set, classifying each query by whether it is a schema-level pattern directly translatable to SPARQL over the released OWL TTL (no Neo4j-only constructs).
scanned_set: SpectraCQ v1.0 design-phase RAN1 competency questions (the same 137-CQ layer reported by cq_coverage.json and cq_results.json)
methodology_note: The queries use SPARQL-expressible constructs only: graph patterns, directed edges, property filters, and standard aggregates (count, avg, collect, case). No apoc.* procedures, no shortestPath, and no method-chain string operations appear. One query (P3_CQ003, the section breadcrumb) uses a variable-length relationship pattern, [:PARENT_SECTION*0..10]; it maps onto SPARQL as a property path (spectra:parentSection+) with the zero-length case supplied by a UNION branch, so it is translatable rather than Neo4j-specific. Fifteen representative Cypher queries from this set are bundled at queries/cypher/, with six worked SPARQL translations at queries/sparql/; the full v1.0 CQ set is not bundled in this package version.
scope_warning: This count describes the design-phase RAN1 layer and is not a statistic about the released SpectraCQ v2.0 benchmark. The released SPARQL layer is a different, larger set: 142 executable translations covering every released RAN1 CQ, at cqs/spectra_cq_v2.0/sparql/, with row-count parity evidence in cq_replay/sparql_parity_results.json (142/142 match). The two counts must never be presented as the same thing.

released_layer_reference.sparql_translations: cqs/spectra_cq_v2.0/sparql/ (142 .rq files, one per released RAN1 CQ)
